workflow: Peptides (20 μg) were used for TMT labeling (TMT10plex Isobaric Label Reagent, Thermo Fisher Scientific)

differential: Only proteins with P value <0.05 and a melting point difference >5 of the comparison from control 1 versus treatment 1 and were considered as targets.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment is a classic TPP (Thermal Proteome Profiling) study using TMT multiplexing and MS3 to minimize ratio compression. The differential analysis is focused on melting point shifts (Tm) rather than simple abundance changes.

acquisition: The most intense ions from the full-scan MS were selected for MS2, using quadrupole isolation.
labeling: Peptides (20 μg) were used for TMT labeling (TMT10plex Isobaric Label Reagent, Thermo Fisher Scientific)
specialized: To identify target proteins capable of interacting with the natural compound, we performed TPP assay in SW48 cells treated with Pae1.
